definitions.explanation: The traffic lane on the right side of a multi-lane road. In Japan, where cars drive on the left, the right lane is typically the passing or turning lane.

examples.japanese: {右車線|みぎしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: I move into the right lane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{右折|うせつ}→右折：09217_usetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{右車線|みぎしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: Since I was turning right, I drove in the right lane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}す→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧とき⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{右車線|みぎしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: The rule of thumb is to use the right lane only when overtaking and then return to the left right away.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧ (right) + ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (traffic lane). In Japan's left-hand traffic, the right lane is generally the overtaking lane and the lane used to prepare for right turns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右車線|みぎしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the right lane
- {右車線|みぎしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to drive in the right lane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{左車線|ひだりしゃせん}→左車線：26706_hidarishasen⟧: left lane — the opposite; in Japan the main travel lane
- ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧: passing lane — names the lane by its function rather than its position
